metaTitle: MBBS in China for Bangladeshi Students | EduExpress International
description: MBBS in China for Bangladeshi students: compare tuition fees, scholarships, university entry requirements, CSCA and the BMDC registration pathway.

universities.name: Chongqing Medical University
universities.housing: CNY 4,800/year · twin room; CNY 9,600/year · single room
universities.admission: Science-stream high school with Mathematics, English, Biology, Chemistry and Physics. Applicants from Bangladesh: minimum 70% in the high-school exit examination. General age range: 18–25.
universities.language: IELTS 6.0 with each component at least 5.0, TOEFL 85 with each component at least 15, Duolingo 105, or accepted evidence of a fully English-taught high school.
universities.scholarship: CNY 15,000 for the first year, awarded to 30% of the freshman enrolment quota through university selection. Submit academic evidence with your application; this is a first-year award.

universities.name: Wenzhou Medical University
universities.expenses: Registration CNY 600 in the first year; insurance CNY 800/year; textbooks at actual cost.
universities.admission: High school qualification with Physics, Chemistry and Biology. General age range: 18–30.
universities.language: Prepare the programme’s accepted English-language evidence and entrance assessment.
universities.scholarship: Freshman awards: CNY 20,000, 10,000 or 5,000; allocation 25%, 25% and 50%. Assessment follows full tuition payment and registration, using entrance performance and CSCA results. Later academic awards have separate assessment.

universities.name: Jiangsu University
universities.housing: CNY 4,900/academic year or CNY 3,000/semester · double room
universities.expenses: Application CNY 200; first-year registration CNY 400 and medical examination CNY 550; insurance CNY 600/year. Residence permit CNY 425 per issuance.
universities.admission: High school degree with results above 70%, B or equivalent. HSK 4 at 180 or above is a graduation requirement.
universities.language: IELTS above 6.0, TOEFL above 80 or Duolingo above 100.
universities.scholarship: Build your base budget using the published tuition. Match any funding application to an award that explicitly includes Clinical Medicine.

universities.name: Xi’an Jiaotong University
universities.expenses: Application CNY 500 for self-funded applications or CNY 800 for scholarship applications.
universities.admission: High school qualification, academic review, language evidence, CSCA results and a comprehensive interview form the selection process.
universities.language: Prepare English-language evidence for the MBBS route.
universities.csca: Prepare the subjects specified for Medicine in your selected programme requirements.
universities.scholarship: The university’s percentage-based International Undergraduate Freshman Scholarship is for non-medical programmes. Medical applicants can explore eligible city and enrolled-student awards under their separate terms.

universities.name: Tongji University
universities.housing: Choose campus accommodation when preparing your room-specific budget.
universities.expenses: Application CNY 600; insurance CNY 400/semester. Add accommodation and living expenses separately.
universities.admission: High school qualification and programme admission assessment. General age range: 18–35.
universities.language: IELTS 6.5 or TOEFL 85; accepted English-medium schooling exemptions follow the programme rules.
universities.csca: Prepare the university’s required CSCA score report for your medical application.
universities.scholarship: Match scholarship coverage to the English-taught MBBS programme when planning your application.

universities.name: Fudan University
universities.housing: Plan accommodation using your assigned campus and room category.
universities.expenses: Application CNY 800. Add housing, insurance, living and travel to the tuition budget.
universities.admission: High school graduate with a strong science background. Academic and programme assessment form part of selection.
universities.language: English-taught MBBS with Chinese and medical Chinese included in the curriculum.
universities.scholarship: Prepare a programme-specific funding enquiry alongside your academic application; budget using the full tuition before any award.

faqs.question: How much does MBBS in China cost?
faqs.answer: The six university examples in this guide list annual tuition from CNY 30,000 to CNY 75,000. Accommodation, insurance, living expenses, documents, travel and service charges are separate. Compare a first-year budget with later years, and apply a scholarship reduction only after an award is confirmed.

faqs.question: How long is MBBS in China?
faqs.answer: The English-taught MBBS programmes featured here last six years, including the programme’s required clinical training and internship. The selected university determines the placement, assessment and graduation requirements.

faqs.question: Can Bangladeshi students practise in Bangladesh after studying medicine in China?
faqs.answer: Yes, graduates can follow the Bangladesh Medical & Dental Council registration pathway. Choose an appropriately authorised medical programme in China, complete the degree and clinical training, and retain your academic and study records. On return, pass the BMDC Registration Qualifying Examination and complete the applicable internship and registration steps before practising.

faqs.question: What GPA is required for MBBS in China?
faqs.answer: Each university sets its own academic entry requirements. Submit SSC and HSC or equivalent results with Biology, Chemistry and Physics, together with the programme’s language and entrance evidence. For example, Chongqing Medical University specifies at least 70% in the high-school exit examination for applicants from Bangladesh; use the selected university’s assessment for your qualification.

faqs.question: Is CSCA required for MBBS in China?
faqs.answer: Prepare for the subjects required by your selected programme. Wenzhou Medical University and Jiangsu University list Mathematics and Chemistry; Fudan lists Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry; Chongqing Medical University lists Mathematics in English for English-medium programmes.

faqs.question: Can I study MBBS in China without IELTS?
faqs.answer: Some programmes accept alternatives. Chongqing Medical University lists TOEFL, Duolingo and accepted evidence of fully English-taught high school study alongside IELTS. Use the English requirements of the university you select.

faqs.question: Are scholarships available for MBBS in China?
faqs.answer: Yes. Examples include Wenzhou Medical University freshman awards up to CNY 20,000 and Chongqing Medical University’s CNY 15,000 first-year award for selected new students. Compare selection, payment timing and continuation conditions; an award for another major may have different eligibility.

faqs.question: Is a foundation or Chinese language course the same as MBBS admission?
faqs.answer: Foundation and language courses develop academic or language skills. Progression to MBBS follows the medical programme’s own science, language, CSCA and selection requirements. Include preparation tuition and living expenses as a separate stage in your plan.

faqs.question: Do I need Chinese for an English-taught MBBS?
faqs.answer: Chinese helps you communicate with patients and clinical teams. Universities include language learning and may set an HSK threshold for clinical training or graduation. Jiangsu University specifies HSK 4 with a score of at least 180 for graduation.

faqs.question: Does a WDOMS listing mean a university is BMDC approved?
faqs.answer: WDOMS identifies medical schools. For English-taught MBBS, match the exact programme to China’s Ministry of Education authorisation. After completing the degree, follow BMDC’s examination, internship and registration requirements for medical practice in Bangladesh.

faqs.question: Is Chinese Ministry of Education recognition enough for English-taught MBBS?
faqs.answer: Choose a university authorised by China’s Ministry of Education to enrol international students in English-taught undergraduate Clinical Medicine, and meet that programme’s academic, language and entrance requirements. General university recognition and permission to run English-taught MBBS are distinct. Your route to practice in Bangladesh continues through BMDC’s qualifying examination and registration process.
